parole.significato: Used to form nouns from adjectives, verbs and other nouns
parole.testo: From Swedish -is (diminutive suffix), from Latin -is.

parole.significato: a bicycle kick
parole.testo: From Swedish brassespark, equivalent to brasilianer (“Brazilian”) + spark (“kick”).

parole.significato: a gay man; gay, fag, queer, poof
parole.testo: From Swedish bög.

parole.significato: fainting
parole.testo: From Swedish dånadimp or dåndimp; dåne (“faint”) + dimp (“fall, dump”).

parole.significato: Term of address for a love interest, darling, (my) love, (my) dear
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish älskling, with the same meaning, equivalent to elske + -ling.

parole.significato: a layer of hard ice crust on the ground
parole.testo: From Swedish fläin (“swollen ice”), possibly related to Swedish flen (“wound, skin growth”).

parole.significato: bare or uncovered
parole.testo: From Swedish flen (“wound, skin growth”), original meaning possibly "swell" or "knot". Possibly related to Swedish fläin (“swollen ice”).

parole.significato: an undertaking (company, business)
parole.testo: From fore- + tak, after Swedish företag.

parole.significato: et fåtall - a few, a small number of
parole.testo: få + tall; from Swedish fåtal

parole.significato: glogg (Scandinavian version of mulled wine)
parole.testo: From Swedish glögg.

parole.significato: gravlax; raw salmon cured under pressure with salt and spices, usually dill
parole.testo: From grave (“to cure fish with salt and spices under pressure”) + laks (“salmon”). The culinary sense of grave is from Swedish grava (“to cure fish”), after Swedish gravad (“cured”). Compare Norwegian Nynorsk gravlaks, Danish gravlaks, Swedish gravlax and Icelandic graflax (“gravlax”).

parole.significato: An old man, geezer, husband, man of the house (lovingly or derogatory)
parole.testo: Unknown, but some believe it to be a shortening of the word godbonde (“good farmer, husband”), also thought to be borrowed directly from Swedish gubbe. Probably akin to the Nynorsk verb guve (“to stand crouching”), which is from Old Norse gaupn (“something bent”).

parole.significato: a pimp, someone who solicits prostitution
parole.testo: From Swedish hallick, from Czech holomek, ultimately from holý (“naked”).

parole.significato: they
parole.testo: Through Swedish hen from Finnish hän.

parole.significato: to imply (something)
parole.testo: inne + bære; from Swedish innebära

parole.significato: to compare
parole.testo: From Swedish jämföra.

parole.significato: A PR stunt or gimmick to attract plenty of attention.
parole.testo: From Swedish jippo.

parole.significato: guy, dude
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish kis.

parole.significato: a girl
parole.testo: Through Swedish from Tavringer Romani tjej, from Romani ćhaj (“girl”). See more at Swedish tjej.

parole.significato: narcotic, illegal drugs
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish knark.

parole.significato: toffee, brittle
parole.testo: From Swedish knäck.

parole.significato: crispbread; a hard, flat and crisp type of bread, usually made from rye flour
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish knäckebröd (“crispbread”), a specifically Swedish formation attested since 1639. parole.significato: a heavy, twisted wooden block; a lump
parole.testo: From Swedish knöl (“hump, bump”).

parole.significato: a hut
parole.testo: From Swedish koja, from Middle Low German koje.

parole.significato: fun, amusing or interesting; cool, nice or appealing
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish kul (“fun, amusing, interesting”), with semantic influence from English cool (“calm, unaffected; fashionable, appealing”). parole.significato: to keep alive
parole.testo: Probably from Swedish livnära

parole.significato: a moped
parole.testo: From Swedish moped.

parole.significato: a sheaf
parole.testo: Likely from Swedish nek. See also Danish neg.

parole.significato: A fried dish consisting of chopped vegetables and meat, traditionally made using leftovers.
parole.testo: From Swedish pyttipanna. Corresponds to Finnish pyttipannu.

parole.significato: beforehand, in advance
parole.testo: From Swedish på förhand.

parole.significato: in order, right
parole.testo: Borrowed from Swedish på G.

parole.significato: travelling construction worker (especially railwaymen)
parole.testo: From Swedish rallare, thought to have risen from English railway.

parole.significato: One who regularly engages in synsing in the national (Norwegian) media.
parole.testo: First used in Norwegian in 1984, from Swedish rikstyckare, from riks- (“pertaining to rike (“kingdom, realm, empire”)”) + synser, from synes.

parole.significato: surströmming (traditional Swedish food made from fermented Baltic herring)
parole.testo: From Swedish surströmming (literally “sour herring”).

parole.significato: a blunder, mistake
parole.testo: From Swedish tabbe.

parole.significato: A built-up area (i.e. a city, town or village), (per Nordic definition a locality with at least 200 inhabitants and up…
parole.testo: From tett + sted, a calque of Swedish tätort.
